title: 📱 AI reaches budget phones!
body: Google has announced that the Gemini app is coming to phones with low memory, after being rebuilt to run smoothly on simpler devices.
The new app supports live voice conversation in more than forty-five languages, helps you understand your surroundings using the camera, and creates images with AI.
Simply put, AI is no longer limited to expensive phones — it is now within everyone's reach.
Have you tried the Gemini assistant before? And does it work well on your phone?
